infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan product labels and barcodes to check them against recalls.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Your location is used to show recalls sold in your state and to find tracked restaurants near you. Only your state is sent to our servers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow 'Always' to get a heads-up when you arrive at a restaurant whose suppliers have an active recall. Only your state is sent to our servers.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose an existing photo of a label to check it against recalls.
